title: Entering the toilet
cue: Refuge from the male and female devils
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabaa'ith
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil ones, male and female [devils].

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 142: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/256
